newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo stumbles after ADRs fall in NY. [CORRECTED 09:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Glaxo stumbles after ADRs fall in NY. [CORRECTED 09:40 GMT]

text.p: Shares in Glaxo Wellcome stumbled on Thursday as a wave of profit-taking in its ADRs in New York pressured the stock amid speculation that Swiss giant Roche Holdings has its sights on SmithKline Beecham, dealers said.
(Deletes reference to speculation that Roche was interested in Glaxo)
At 0845 GMT, shares in Glaxo were down 9-1/2p to 999p, but off the day's low of 993.
Glaxo's ADRs fell $1/2 to $33-1/2 in New York and Zeneca Group's ADRs lost $3/4 to $84-1/8, as the Dow lost 29.07 points on profit-taking.
SmithKline's ADRs rose $1-3/8 to $67-3/8 after the shares jumped 29-1/2p in London on talk that the Swiss drug giant may be preparing for a hostile bid or agreed merger.
"So much support for these international stocks comes from the U.S.," said one dealer, noting the decline in Glaxo's ADRs.
